About the salon

A full nail menu on West 4th

LV Nails is a nail salon at 1155 W 4th St #115 in Reno. Come in for a manicure or pedicure, or for length and shape with acrylics, dip powder, gel extensions and nail art. Men's manicures and pedicures are on the menu too.

Booking is simple: call or text (775) 322-9800 and ask for a time.
